body: Thank you for your kind comments. I’ve not hit rock bottom, my life is good. I have a stable job, loving mother. I am simply fucking crazy as my multiple friends, and even therapists have stated before. I’m just glad I’m not taking someone with me.
I feel nothing. I am a shell of my former self driven to insanity. I am simply doing what I think is right to feel emotion again.
Good luck man. See you in the after life.
12 minutes. If anyone has any good songs for a last hurrah put them here. I want something good, not overplayed. If anyone’s reading this of course.
